recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7870 unless Patient Care reopens the broader Goal.source/Goal.recorder modeling question under a newer tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-7870 was a Published Patient Care DSTU1 change request asking to add Goal.Informant because a goal may be patient-stated while someone else records it. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected adding a new Informant element and instead required a usage note on Goal.author clarifying that it identifies who is responsible for creating the goal, not who typed it into the system, with data entry handled through Provenance.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN #6806. Git commit 8bd3bd917d537625fad908b5f0f6277d113b941e is the corresponding git-svn Goal tracker commit and added the Goal.author comment: the element is the individual responsible for establishing the goal, not necessarily who recorded it, with Provenance used for the recording aspect.
additional_context: Current build configuration lists Goal as active and maps old Goal.author through Goal.expressedBy to current Goal.source. The active Goal StructureDefinition now includes Goal.source for the person/team responsible for establishing the goal and Goal.recorder for who recorded it. Later Applied issue FHIR-48366 intentionally kept Goal.source, added Goal.recorder, and removed the obsolete Provenance-only aside; FHIR-41409 only broadened Goal.source to Group/family use.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already implements the accepted FHIR-7870 semantic outcome through Goal.source plus Goal.recorder, and adding Goal.Informant or reintroducing the old Provenance-only wording would conflict with later applied modeling.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision added Goal.recorder and preserved Goal.source, confirming the current source/recorder split relevant to the original author/informant distinction.
Applied R6 decision added Group/family support and the current Group-use comment on Goal.source without changing the source-vs-recorder semantics.
